about: English prompts to say in Arabic. keys = SRS card keys of the vocabulary each prompt uses; the Speaking page sorts prompts by how many of those words the learner already knows. Entries with source "core" are CONSTRUCTED sentences (2026-09-05, his rule): at most 7 words, one grammar frame each, built from the class vocabulary plus words he already holds — the sentences a lesson practises. Passages are read, never repeated.
